_source: Agarwal et al., MADE, ACL 2026, https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.2148/. Task framing and rules from the paper's prompting setup (App. A.7.1-A.7.2, pp. 46325-46328; identical text in raunak-agarwal/made-benchmark@9bff3ec prompts/system_prompt_k10.txt and user_prompt_template.txt): 'classifying a medical device adverse event report into one or more categories according to the FDA taxonomy', 'Assign all the labels that are relevant to the report', 'Labels that start with "A" are Medical Device Problems. Labels that start with "E" are Health Effects - Clinical Signs and Symptoms or Conditions', and the rule that a selected child label implies its parent and grandparent. Each label is shown in the paper's label-line format '{code}: {term} - {definition}' (prompts/README.md), term and definition verbatim from IMDRF Adverse Event Terminology Release 2025, Annex A (Medical Device Problem) and Annex E (Health Effects - Clinical Signs and Symptoms or Conditions) - the paper's label source ('official IMDRF annexes', Section 2; IMDRF accessed 19-11-2025). The label vocabulary (1,154 codes) is the union of head_medium_tail.json.
_primitive: noul per IMDRF code (multi-label). Hierarchical traversal (see src/gauntlet/tasks/made.py): round 1 asks the 51 top-level codes; each later round asks the unasked codes with a parent accepted (P > 0.5) earlier, all of a round's questions in one request over the same state.
_additions: Not in the paper's prompt: the primary IMDRF hierarchy path in parentheses (annex title and the terms of the code's ancestors on its code-prefix path, or its first listed IMDRF path if IMDRF does not list the prefix path), and for codes with children the sentence 'The code also applies whenever a more specific code under it applies.' (the paper's up-propagation rule, Section 2). No few-shot examples (the paper's prompting baselines use 10 kNN-retrieved training reports; Jev is zero-shot).

A01.definition: Problem related to the interaction between the patient and the device.

A0101.definition: Problem associated with the interaction between the patient's physiology or anatomy and the device that affects the patient and/or the device.

A010101.definition: Problem associated with undesirable local or systemic effects due to exposure to medical device materials or leachates from those materials by a patient who has an implant or is receiving treatment with a device made from them.

A010102.definition: The device appears to elicit undesired response in the patient to the presence of an implanted or invasive device, without inherent device failure, e.g. fibrous encapsulation, or inflammation of the tissue around the device, or extrusion of the device.

A010103.term: Inadequacy of Device Shape and/or Size
A010103.definition: The physical size and/or shape of the device was inadequate with regard to the patient's anatomy.

A0102.definition: Problem associated with interconnection between the bone tissue and the implanted device.

A010201.definition: Problem associated with the failure to see direct anchorage of an implant by the formation of bony tissue around the implant without the growth of fibrous tissue at the bone-implant interface.

A010202.definition: Problem associated with weakened integration of the device at the bone-implant interface due to loss of fibrous and/or bony tissue and leading to compromised anchorage of the device. i.e. Loosening/Lysis

A0103.term: Loosening of Implant Not Related to Bone-Ingrowth
A0103.definition: Problem associated with the loss of direct anchorage of an implanted device over time or due to an injury.

A0104.definition: Problem with an implanted or invasive device moving within the body, or being completely expelled from the body.

A010401.definition: Problem with all or part of an implanted or invasive device being completely expelled from its intended location within the body.

A010402.definition: Problem with all or part of an implanted or invasive device moving from its intended location within the body.

A0105.definition: Problems associated with a product having less efficacy than expected. No other malfunctions could be identified.

A0106.definition: Problem associated with the narrowing or obstruction of the device (e.g. prosthetic heart valves, stents, etc.).

A02.definition: Problem associated with any deviations from the intended performance of the device that appear to relate to the manufacturing, packaging or shipping processes.

A0201.definition: Problem associated with an inherent device characteristic that is not satisfactory as specified or delivered.

A020101.definition: Problem associated with a device not being as sharp as intended or expected.

A020102.definition: Problem associated with the device that does not meet the specifications or requirements for which it was manufactured (e.g. materials, parts, manufacturing process).

A0202.definition: Problem associated with a device component having flaws of dimensional deviations greater than acceptable for the intended use.

A0203.definition: Problem associated with having flaws or dimensional deviations greater than acceptable for the intended use of the device.

A0204.definition: Problem associated with packaging or shipping damage prior to the use of the device.

A0205.definition: Problem associated with the materials used to construct the cover or outer wrapping of the device.

A020501.term: Difficult to Open or Remove Packaging Material
A020501.definition: Problem associated with difficulty for users to operate the device, specifically as it relates to the opening or removal of the outer wrapping.

A020502.definition: Problem associated with the nonconformance to the device specifications due to incomplete or missing packaging that may compromise the device operation as intended.

A020503.definition: Problem associated with the loss of packaging seal.

A020504.term: Tear, Rip or Hole in Device Packaging
A020504.definition: Problem associated with packaging damage (tear, rip or hole) prior to the use of the device.

A0206.definition: A device found incorrectly assembled when delivered to the user facility.

A020601.definition: A device found to have one or more components incorrectly assembled when delivered to the user facility. This includes cases in which components are interchanged.

A020602.definition: A device component(s) found to be missing when delivered to the user facility.

A020603.definition: More than the usual number of components present/additional components from this or other devices.

A0207.term: Device Damaged Prior to Receipt by User
A0207.definition: Problem associated with packaging or shipping damage prior to receipt by the user.

A020701.definition: Problem associated with a device being received in such a manner to indicate that its sterility has been compromised (e.g. sterile packaging breached, visible contaminate present)

A03.definition: Problem associated with any from the documented specifications of the device that relate to any chemical characterization, i.e., element, compound, or mixture.

A0301.definition: Problem associated with an unexpected or inappropriate smell released by the device.

A0302.definition: Problem associated with any deviations from the documented specifications of the device that relate to any ingredient or reagent characterization.

A030201.term: Clumping in Device or Device Ingredient
A030201.definition: Problem associated with the aggregation of particles into irregular masses.

A030202.term: Coagulation in Device or Device Ingredient
A030202.definition: Problem associated with the undesired characterization of congealing, solidifying, thickening, curdling.

A030203.term: Precipitate in Device or Device Ingredient
A030203.definition: Problem associated with the separation of solid particles from a liquid as the result of a chemical or physical change.

A030204.definition: Problem associated with the degree to which an antibody or antigen participates in cross reactions.

A030205.definition: Substances that consist of separate particles that are introduced by the device during use.

A030208.definition: Color of product is different from that expected.

A0303.definition: Problem associated with an unexpected or incomplete chemical reaction or effect.

A04.definition: Problem associated with any deviations from the documented specifications of the device that relate to the limited durability of all material used to construct device.

A0401.definition: Problem associated with undesired damage or breakage of those materials used in the device construction.

A040101.definition: Problem associated with a partial or full-thickness crack in the device materials.

A040102.term: Loss of or Failure to Bond
A040102.definition: Problem associated with lack or loss of adherence between materials intended to be joined together by any bonding such as an adhesive, heat welding, etc.

A040103.definition: Problem associated with small pieces of the device breaking off unexpectedly.

A040104.definition: Problem associated with undesired damage or breakage in a solder joint of materials used in the device construction.

A0402.definition: Problem associated with the pressure inside a vessel or container rising to such a degree that the container ruptures.

A0403.definition: Problem associated with the violent bursting due to the sudden expansion of air, gas or fluid.

A0404.definition: Problem associated with an undesired partial separation and/or a visible opening along the length or width in the materials that are used in the device construction.

A0405.definition: Problem associated with a undesired change in the chemical structure, physical properties, or appearance in the materials that are used in the device construction.

A040501.definition: Problem associated with buildup of calcium salts on the device.

A040502.definition: Problem associated with the chemical or electrochemical reaction between materials, usually a metal and its environment that produces a deterioration of the metal and its properties.

A040503.definition: Problem associated with a progressive loss of a material from a solid surface.

A040504.definition: Problem associated with the corrosion of a material's surface, confined to a point or small area that takes the form of cavities.

A040505.definition: Problem associated with the detachment of small pieces of the coating film of a material.

A040506.definition: Peeling or delamination of composite materials, including coatings, that occurs when layers are separated as a result of stress or impact and resulting in loss of mechanical toughness.

A040507.definition: Problem associated with material damage to a surface, usually involving progressive loss or displacement of material, due to relative motion between that surface and a contacting substance or substances.

A040508.definition: Problem due to the undesired unravelling of material (e.g. disentangled, unwound etc.).

A0406.definition: Problem associated with an undesired material change in shape or property caused by external forces.

A040601.definition: Problem associated with an undesired bulge, bend, bow, kink, or wavy condition observed in the device material resulting from compressive stresses.

A040602.definition: Problem associated with a undesired change in shape, characterized by the presence of a slight hollow (dent) in the device surface.

A040603.definition: Problem associated with an undesired material change in physical property, characterized by failure to fold.

A040604.definition: Problem associated with the comprising materials' deformation in that device fails to open its wrapping or open/extend in a certain manner i.e. balloon or lens.

A040605.definition: Problem associated with the comprising materials having damaged edges.

A040606.definition: Problem associated with an undesired material change in shape, characterized by the infolding of one part within another part of a structure.

A040607.definition: Problem associated with undesired rigidity of device material (resisting deformation in response to an applied force).

A040608.definition: Problem associated with any device material that results in the material's inability to maintain the desired shape or support function.

A040609.definition: Problem associated with deformations that lead to twisting or bending of the device.

A040610.definition: Problem associated with a solid device being transformed into a molten or liquid state.

A040611.definition: Problem associated with an increase or elongation in a materials' dimension.

A040612.definition: Device is thickened due to deformation. Note: Not to be used for thickening of liquid.

A0407.definition: Problem associated with an undesired streak, pattern and/or a noticeable change in color from the rest of the materials used in the device construction.

A0408.definition: Problem associated with material breaking into small particles.

A0409.definition: Problem associated with an undesirable opaqueness or cloudiness.

A0410.definition: Material constituting device is perforated possibly compromising the device's intended purpose.

A041001.definition: Device material(s) punctured leading to undesired holes/openings.

A0411.definition: Problem associated with undesired physical appearance of device material, specifically when material extends beyond or above device surface.

A0412.definition: Problem associated with perforations that lead to bursting of the device.

A0413.definition: Problem associated with an undesired disassociation or breaking apart of the device.

A0414.definition: Problem associated with materials consisting the device are split, cut or torn due to external forces (e.g. wrenching or laceration) or internal forces (e.g. exceeding the tensile stress limits belonging to the materials used in the device construction).

A0415.definition: Problem associated with an undesirable shallow cut or narrow groove in the surface of the device materials.

A05.definition: Problems associated with mechanical actions or defects, including moving parts or subassemblies, etc.

A0501.term: Detachment of Device or Device Component
A0501.definition: Problem associated with the separation of the device from its physical construct, integrity, or chassis.

A0502.definition: Problem associated with one device causing harm to another device.

A0503.definition: Problems associated with the inability or unexpected ejection or discharge of the device from its physical location.

A050301.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to be ejected or discharged from its physical location.

A050302.definition: Problem associated with unexpected ejection of the device from its physical location. This includes but is not limited to devices such as clip appliers, film cartridge, and staples.

A0504.definition: Problem associated with the escape or ingress of a liquid (including blood and bodily fluids), gas or radiation from or into a vessel or container.

A050401.definition: Escape (Release, Discharge) of fluid (including blood or bodily fluid) through an unintended location; often accompanied by a loss of pressure and/or output. This includes both external and internal fluid leak. This does not include fluidized powder leak.

A050402.definition: Problem associated with the unintended escape of a gas/air from the container in which it is housed. This also includes both external and internal air/gas leak.

A050403.definition: Escape (Release, Discharge) of gel through an unintended location - as in leakage of ultrasound gel. Escape or release of gel from containment structures - as in gel filled implant leak.

A050404.definition: Escape of radiation (energy in the form of waves or subatomic particles, especially those that cause ionization) through containment structures, leading to unintended exposure.

A050405.definition: Problem associated with the escape of blood around a heart valve, particularly around its leaflets. Also known as paravalvular leak.

A050406.definition: Problem associated with the escape or backward flow of blood through or across the valve.  Also known as transvalvular regurgitation

A050407.definition: Escape (release, discharge) of powder (including particulates) through an unintended location,  often accompanied by a loss of pressure and/or output.

A050408.definition: The observed device problem is persistent blood flow/pressure in the aneurysm sac following an endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) procedure.  Where other device problems lead to an endoleak the observed problems should be coded and E2121 selected as the E term.

A0505.definition: Problem associated with the device not discharging as intended.

A050501.definition: Problem associated with failure of the device to discharge its load (e.g. surgical stapler failed to partially or completely deploy its staples).

A050502.definition: Problem associated with a therapy or algorithm not being delivered or executed at the expected time.

A0506.definition: The motion of the device is prevented or restricted.

A0507.definition: Problem associated with a device mechanical functioning of machinery, moving parts or tools of device being changed or modified.

A050701.definition: Problem associated with a circuit, equipment, or system whereby its functions fail to be properly synchronized or its relative positions properly oriented.

A050702.definition: Inability of the device to make an incision, pierce or open as intended.

A050703.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to complete a series of processes or events.

A050704.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to connect tissue with a stapling device due to the staples not forming correctly.

A050705.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to seal the intended vessel with the device intended to provide a seal (e.g. electrosurgical hemostasis).

A0508.definition: Problem associated with any unintended sound which emanates from the device (for example, squeaking from two parts rubbing together or buzzing sounds from electrical components).

A0509.definition: Problem associated with the lack of movement in the device due parts sticking or seizing.

A050901.definition: Strength of an adhesive bond is too great; typically used when the adhesive is meant as a temporary hold but is acting in a more permanent manner.

A0510.definition: Problem associated with drawing back the device to an intended location.

A0511.definition: Problem associated with the basic physical construction or physical make up of the device.

A051101.definition: Problem associated with the buckling or crushing of material from external forces.

A051102.definition: The device has undesirable sharp edges which can cause harm or damage.

A051103.term: Difficult to Fold, Unfold or Collapse
A051103.definition: Problem associated with the use of the device in terms of user experiencing difficulty to close or to spread out/extend length of the device, even if the operation is being performed according to labeled instructions for use.

A051104.definition: Problem associated with the use of the device in terms of user experiencing difficulty opening and closing the device, even if the operation is being performed according to labeled instructions for use.

A051105.definition: Problem associated with the heart valve leaflet not closing properly.

A0512.definition: Problem associated with an undesired movement of the device, which may be related to the device malfunction, misdiagnosis, or mistreatment.

A051201.definition: Problems associated with the device not remaining in an expected location.

A051202.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to stay in an upright position.

A051203.definition: Problem associated with the device or a component unexpectedly being dropped or moving down from an intended place.

A051204.definition: Problem associated with the device moving or sliding from the intended position.

A051205.definition: Problem associated with the device impacting with another object.

A051206.definition: Problem associated with any motion of the system or components that was not initiated by the user.

A051207.definition: Problem associated with the mechanical stability of the device.

A051208.definition: Problem associated with the undesirable mechanical oscillation.

A06.definition: Problem associated with transmission of visible light affecting the quality of the image transmitted or otherwise affecting the intended application of the visible light path.

A0601.definition: The problem relates to the poor focusing of the object or the focus is on the wrong object or in the wrong area.

A0602.definition: Problem associated with being off-center of optical lenses.

A0603.definition: Problem associated with an undesired change of color.

A0604.definition: Problem associated with an optical defect in an image-forming system whereby the image is not the shape of an ideal image of the object.

A0605.definition: Problem associated with the blocking of optical devices, e.g. visual pathways.

A07.definition: Problem associated with the function of the electrical circuitry of the device.

A0701.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to achieve successful depolarization and contraction of a cardiac chamber caused by a pacemaker output pulse.

A070101.definition: Problem associated with the failure to achieve effective and consistent depolarization of the heart resulting from the electrical stimulus of the pacemaker.

A070102.definition: Problem with the amount of output energy needed to cause cardiac depolarization being higher than expected/desired.

A070103.definition: Problem associated with the ineffective and inconsistent depolarization of the heart.

A070104.definition: Problem with the amount of output energy needed to cause cardiac depolarization being unstable.

A0702.definition: Problem associated with the excessive production of electrical impulses over a period.

A0703.definition: Problem associated with electrical current flowing through a gap between two conductive surfaces, typically resulting in a visible flash of light.

A070301.definition: Problem associated with electrical current flowing through a gap between paddles (conductive surfaces), typically resulting in a visible flash of light.

A070302.definition: Problem associated with electrical current flowing through a gap between electrodes (conductive surfaces), typically resulting in a visible flash of light.

A0704.definition: Problem associated with a flash of light related to an electrical discharge into a normally non conductive medium, such as air. Not associated with a discharge between two conductive surfaces.

A0705.definition: Problem associated with the internal power of the device (e.g. battery, transformer, fuel cell or other power sources).

A070501.definition: Problem related to increased battery internal impedance.

A070502.definition: Problem related to decreased battery internal impedance.

A070503.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to operate when not connected to a fixed power source.

A0706.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to successfully charge an electrical source.

A070601.definition: Problem associated with the premature ending of the charging process (e.g. of a battery or other charge storage device).

A070602.definition: Problem associated with an unexpected amount of time required to charge the device (e.g. a delay in starting charging or a longer than expected charge time).

A070603.definition: Problem associated with inability to initiate the appropriate charging process (e.g. of a battery or other charge storage device)

A0707.definition: Problem associated with the failure of a battery or other charge storage device to appropriately discharge as intended. Does not apply to defibrillation.

A0708.definition: Problem associated with the energy to operate the device.

A070801.definition: Problem associated with the lack of power to run the device.

A070802.definition: Problem associated with an intermittent disruption to the power to run the device.

A070803.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to turn on related to energy delivered to the device.

A070804.definition: Problem associated with the device turning on when not intended.

A0709.definition: Problem associated with the device feature that are designed to respond to a physical stimulus (temperature, illumination, motion, cardiac rhythms) and that do not transmit a resulting signal for interpretation or measurement.

A070901.definition: Problem with the device being less sensitive to an input than intended or expected.

A070902.definition: Problem with the device being more sensitive to an input than intended or expected.

A070903.definition: Problem with the device not analyzing a signal.

A070904.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device to select the appropriate input signal.

A070905.definition: Problem associated with the amount of input required by the device to detect a signal being higher than expected/desired.

A070906.definition: Problem associated with the amount of an input required by the device to detect a signal being lower than expected/desired.

A070907.definition: Problem associated with the loss of the minimum amount of energy, voltage, or current needed to consistently stimulate the heart muscle.

A070908.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device designed to respond to a physical stimulus (as temperature, illumination, motion) to transmit a resulting signal for interpretation or measurement.

A070909.definition: Problem related to failure of the device to properly filter cardiac signals resulting in inappropriate device response.

A070910.definition: Problem related to failure of the device to properly detect intrinsic cardiac activity and respond appropriately.

A070911.definition: Problem with the device receiving an incoming signal on an intermittent basis when expected to be continuous.

A070912.definition: Problem with the device inappropriately analyzing a signal.

A0710.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to allow a current of electricity to pass or to conduct electricity continuously along an electrical path.

A0711.definition: Problems associated with the device's ability to respond to signals from a system designed to interrogate its status.

A071101.definition: Problem associated with difficulty of a transponder system to trigger a response.

A071102.definition: Problem associated with the device failure to appropriately respond to signals from a system designed to interrogate its status.

A0712.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to generate a therapeutic simulated heart beat via electrical impulses.

A071201.definition: Failure of the device therapy or set of therapies to terminate the harmful cardiac rhythm that the therapy is meant to terminate.

A071202.definition: Problem associated with an error due to imperfect timing of two operations, e.g. signal transmission time.

A071203.definition: Failure of the device to generate a correctly-shaped pacing output, e.g., a waveform that is too wide.

A071204.definition: Problem associated with the device ceasing to deliver paces.

A071205.definition: A device with a pacing function found in back-up Mode. This may be an appropriate fail-safe action (e.g. end of battery life), or be caused by device malfunction or due to operator error.

A071206.definition: Problem associated with a pacing transmission process such that between any two significant instants in the same group, there is always an integral number of unit intervals. Between two significant instants located in different groups, there are not always an integral number of unit intervals.

A071207.definition: Pacing voltage or pulse width is less than desired.

A071208.definition: Problem associated with the failure of pacing device for a limited period of time, following which the item recovers its ability to perform its required function without being subjected to any external corrective action. Note: such as failure is often recurrent.

A071209.definition: Problem associated with undesired pacemaker induced stimulation of extracardiac (muscle) tissue (e.g. diaphragm, pectoral or intercostal muscle)

A0713.definition: Problem associated with the delivery of electrical shock/stimulation by a device intended to deliver shocks/stimulation.

A071301.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device to deliver electrical energy.

A071302.definition: A shock was delivered with incorrect energy level or at incorrect timing.

A071303.definition: Problem associated with the failure to deliver electrical energy for a limited period of time, following which the item recovers its ability to perform its required function without being subjected to any external corrective action. Note: such a failure is often recurrent.

A0714.definition: The device delivers unintended electrical shock. Use this term for devices that are not intended to deliver shocks/stimulation.

A0715.definition: Problem associated with the inability to connect conductors of an electronic system for the purpose of controlling or impeding ground currents and voltages.

A0716.definition: Problem associated with an electrical activity that exceeded the specified threshold limit of the internal integrated circuitry.

A0717.definition: Problem associated with the discharge of electricity between two bodies previously electrically charged.

A0718.definition: Problem associated with the device not powering off when a shut down was requested.

A071801.definition: Problem associated with the device continuing to be in an active state after deactivation was requested.

A0719.definition: Problem associated with the device unexpectedly powering down.

A0720.definition: Problem associated with the ability of a system to function in its electromagnetic environment without introducing intolerable disturbances to anything in its environment.

A072001.definition: Problem associated with a measure of electromagnetic radiation from equipment.

A072002.definition: Problem associated with the degradation of the reception of a wanted signal caused by RF disturbance.

A0721.definition: Problem associated with a failure of the internal network paths or electrical circuitry (i.e. electrical components, circuit boards, wiring)

A072101.definition: Problem associated with the transfer of energy within an electrical network by means of the capacitance between circuit nodes. It occurs when energy is coupled from one circuit to another through an electric field.

A072102.definition: Problem associated with an electric current travelling along an accidental path (unintended path) in a circuit.

A072103.definition: Problem associated with intermittent faults in electrical/electronic interconnections.

A0722.definition: Problem associated with electrical impedance levels between device and patient connections.

A072201.definition: Problem associated with higher than intended electrical impedance levels between device and patient connections.

A072202.definition: Problem associated with lower than intended electrical impedance levels between device and patient connections.

A0723.definition: A device switches mode unexpectedly e.g. back-up mode or electrocautery mode.

A08.definition: Problem associated with the operation of the device, related to its accuracy, and associated with the calibration of the device.

A0801.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device to perform a self-calibration procedure or process designed to assure the accuracy and proper performance of the device.

A0802.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device which is unable to regain a standard level of accuracy when performing a calibration procedure or process designed to assure the accuracy and proper performance of the device.

A0803.definition: Problem associated with the device providing imprecise measurements when compared to a reference standard.

A0804.definition: Problem associated with an adjustment that surpasses a set of criteria.

A0805.definition: Problem associated with an adjustment that falls below a set of criteria.

A09.definition: Problem associated with any deviation from the documented specifications of the device that relate to the end result, data, or test results provided by the device.

A0901.definition: Problem with any deviation from the documented specifications of the device that relate to audible feedback. e.g. voice prompts or beeps, but not safety related alarms which are covered under "Protective Measures Problem".

A090101.definition: Problem with audible messages which do not guide a device user to the correct action.

A090102.definition: Problem associated with audible prompts which cannot be heard clearly.

A090103.definition: Problem associated with the device ceasing to provide audible prompts.

A0902.definition: Problem with any deviation from the documented specifications of the device that relate to visual feedback. e.g. the display of information, images on a screen, or output from the device.

A090201.definition: Problem associated with providing incorrect display information.

A090202.definition: Problem associated with legibility of the display, compromising for instance  the reading/interpretation of patient parameters or test results. Legibility problems can be due to color, size of font, display screen contrast or other factors.

A090203.definition: A device does not consistently display the same message, result, reading, or image. e.g. the display might flicker, switch between readings or messages, or go completely blank for brief periods of time.

A090204.definition: Problem with image display leading to corrupted images or readouts/measurement indications.

A090205.definition: Problem associated with an incorrect image orientation on the device display.

A090206.definition: Problem associated with the absence of display or image.

A090207.definition: Problem associated with the device ceasing to provide visual feedback.

A090208.definition: Inadequate quality of an image or any visual representation displayed by the device, or output from the device.

A090209.definition: Problem with visual messages which continue to be displayed on/by the device after the appropriate action has been taken.

A0903.definition: Problem with any deviation from the documented specifications of the device that relate to tactile feedback. e.g device vibrational prompt.

A090301.definition: Problem with tactile feedback which does not guide a device user to the correct action.

A090302.definition: Problem associated with the device ceasing to provide tactile feedback.

A0904.definition: Problem with the device's intended output of energy.

A090401.definition: Problem associated with the energy output from the device not being in the expected part of the spectrum.

A090402.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device to deliver any energy.

A090403.definition: Problem associated with the energy output from the device being inconsistent over time.

A090404.definition: Device output is exceeding the documented specifications of the device.

A090405.definition: Device output is below the documented specifications of the device.

A090406.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device to deliver the output required for treatment or identification of a disease.

A090407.term: Therapy Delivered to Incorrect Body Area
A090407.definition: Problem associated with the device causing unintended therapeutic action to an area of the body other than the intended area.

A0905.definition: Problem with the device's intended output of radiation.

A090501.definition: Problem associated with the absence of radiation output from radiological or diagnostic devices.

A090502.definition: Problem associated with excessive radiation emitted from radiological or diagnostic devices.

A090503.definition: Problem associated with too little radiation emitted from radiological or diagnostic devices.

A090504.definition: Device-emitted radiation when it was not supposed to. This applies to devices which are intended to emit radiation, and the radiation being emitted from the correct part of the device, but at an incorrect time. Use "radiation leak" if the device emits radiation which should never have been emitted, or from a location from which it should never be emitted.

A0907.definition: Problem associated with no measurement outcome, value or data obtained from the device.

A0908.term: Incorrect, Inadequate or Imprecise Result or Readings
A0908.definition: Problem associated with a nonconforming end result, data, or test results provided by the device to its performance specifications.

A090801.definition: Problem associated with impurities or interference in a signal (e.g. ECG artifact).

A090802.definition: The device does not collect or transfer the sample.

A090803.definition: Problem associated with the device incorrectly reporting that something has not been detected and may mislead the operator/user/HCP into not taking certain actions when action should be taken.

A090804.definition: Problem associated with the device incorrectly reporting that something has been detected and may mislead the operatorr/user/HCP to take certain actions.

A090805.definition: Measurement obtained from or provided by the device is obviously incorrect.

A090806.definition: Device results cannot be reliably reproduced.

A090807.definition: Reading provided by the device is too high or higher than expected.

A090808.definition: Reading provided by the device is too low or lower than expected.

A090809.definition: Test results provided by the device are too high or higher than expected.

A090810.definition: Test results provided by the device are too low or lower than expected.

A090811.definition: The device does not provide or display a valid reading.

A090812.definition: Problem associated with the results of a test or measurement not appearing.

A090813.definition: Reports of erroneous/discrepant results which combine high/low and/or positive/negative results. This term is not to be selected where reports indicate consistently high or low or false positive or false negative results.

A090814.definition: Implanted device is difficult to detect on imaging modalities, e.g. insufficient visibility.

A0909.definition: Problem associated with the use of the device for therapeutic purposes.

A10.definition: Problem associated with the device producing unintended temperatures.

A1001.definition: Problem associated with the device producing temperatures that are lower than specified.

A1002.definition: Problem associated with the device which have a warming or heating function, producing excessive heat.

A1003.definition: Problem associated with the device insufficiently cooled in device active (working) or/and non-active (nonworking) state.

A1004.definition: Problem associated with the device or its components producing temperatures that are not as high as what is specified.

A1005.definition: Problem associated with the device producing high temperatures, such that its operation is compromised or harm is caused (e.g. overheating that produces melting of components or automatic shutdown).

A1006.definition: Problems associated with a discoloration or destruction as a result of thermal decomposition of the device.

A1007.definition: Problem associated with the combustion of the device with a steady flame.

A1008.definition: Problem associated with device-related burn with an unsteady flame.

A1009.definition: Problem associated with a cloud of vapor or gas generated from the device, generally associated after a fire or a burn.

A11.definition: Problem associated with written programs, codes, and/or software system that affects device performance or communication with another device.

A1101.definition: Problem associated with the deviations from documented system specifications that affects overall system performance and/or the performance of an individual device connected to that system.

A1102.definition: Problem associated with the requirement for software to fulfill its function within an intended use or application.

A110201.term: Application Program Freezes or Fails to Launch
A110201.definition: Problem associated with an application program which freezes and/or fails to launch.

A110202.term: Application Program Problem: Dose Calculation Error
A110202.definition: Problem associated with the written program code or application software used by the device to calculate specific measurements or quantities managed by the device.

A110203.definition: Event in which the device software results in errors of medication preparation or administration.

A110204.term: Application Program Problem: Parameter Calculation Error
A110204.definition: Problem associated with the written program code or application software used by the device to calculate parameters other than those related to dose or power.

A110205.term: Application Program Problem: Power Calculation Error
A110205.definition: Problem associated with the written program code or application software used by the device for calculations related to device power.

A110206.term: Application Program Version or Upgrade Problem
A110206.definition: Problem associated with installing updates to a software system that affects the device performance or communication with another device.

A110207.definition: Problem associated with installing the device software in a manner that allows full functioning of the device. Source of installation could be manufacturer or user.

A110208.definition: Problem associated with an unintended shut down by malfunction of the application program.

A1103.definition: Problem associated with execution problems relating to program or algorithm.

A110301.definition: Problem associated with delayed execution relating to program or algorithm.

A110302.definition: Problem associated with intermittent execution relating to program or algorithm.

A110303.definition: Problem associated with the failure of a program or algorithm to execute. Sudden/unexpected interruption to a program's execution.

A1104.definition: Problem associated with software, firmware, and/or hardware elements that control the execution of computer programs and provides such services as computer resource allocation, job control, input/output control, and file management in a computer system.

A110401.definition: Problem associated with malfunction of the computer operating system as opposed to an application software problem.

A110402.term: Operating System Version or Upgrade Problem
A110402.definition: Problem associated with replacing an older operating system to an up-to-date operating system.

A1105.definition: Problem associated with unauthorized access to or modification of a software system resulting in a loss of confidentiality, integrity, or availability of written program code, application software, or data or entire device.

A110501.definition: Problem associated with the acquisition of computer programming codes that can replicate and spread from one computer system to another thereby leading to damaged software, hardware and data.

A110502.definition: Problem associated with an access that was not permitted to the computer system that may lead to modification of program, corruption of data, or and break in network security. This concept is closely associated with computer integrity which is the degree to which a system or component prevents unauthorized access to, or modification of, computer programs or data.

A1106.definition: Problems relating to a system, component, file, procedure, or person available to replace or help restore a primary item in the event of a failure or externally caused disaster.

A110601.definition: Problem associated with the inability to backup or to retrieve a backed up version (corrupted file) of device data or system files.

A1107.definition: Event in which data (charting, orders, results) is not correctly stored, transferred, updated, or displayed.

A110701.definition: Event in which data is unintentionally permanently or temporarily lost, deleted, corrupted, or overwritten.

A110702.definition: Event in which data is accessed by the healthcare provider and either the wrong patient or the wrong data is retrieved despite correct inquiry procedures.

A1108.definition: Problem associated with programming of calendar dates and/or time as a factor in the operation of the device.

A12.definition: Problem associated with linking of the device and/or the functional units set up to provide means for a transfer of liquid, gas, electricity or data.

A1201.definition: Problem associated with linking of the device whereby their functional units set up to provide means for a transfer of fluid, gas, or data is prevented or impeded.

A1202.definition: Problem associated with the device being unassociated in such a way that fluid, gas, power or signal information may not be transferred from one to another.

A1203.definition: Problem associated with the linking of the device having a sufficient open space to prevent gas, liquid or electrical current flow between connectors.

A1204.definition: Problem associated with the linking of the device whereby termination of the transfer of liquid, gas, electricity, or information cannot be accomplished, or linking components do not come apart, or disconnect, when expected.

A1205.definition: Problem associated with the connection of the device being loose or intermittent.

A1206.definition: Problem associated with the connection of the device being improper or not in accordance with device specification, requirements or intended uses.

A1207.definition: Problem associated with a partial linking of the device whereby device may appear to be connected however only a partial, intermittent or no transfer of liquid, gas, electricity, or information can be accomplished.

A1208.definition: Problem associated with the connection of the device whereby channels, switching systems, and other functional units set up to provide means for a transfer of liquid, gas, electricity, or information do not match or fit.

A13.definition: Problem associated with the device sending or receiving signals or data. This includes transmission among internal components of the device to which the device is intended to communicate.

A1301.definition: Problem associated with a failure of the device to read a signal for interpretation or measurement.

A1302.definition: Problem associated with a failure of the device to transmit a record for interpretation or measurement.

A1303.definition: Inconsistent or lack of intended communication of data among internal components or with other external devices.

A1304.definition: Problem associated with variability of the transmission of telemetry signals.

A1305.definition: Problems with the RF wireless technology characteristics and performance (e.g., frequency, output power, range, reception), wireless quality of service, wireless coexistence, security of wireless signals and data, and electromagnetic compatibility.

A14.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to deliver or draw liquids or gases as intended (e.g. delivering drugs at incorrect rate, problems with drawing fluid from a system). This includes vacuum collection devices and manual or mechanical pumps.

A1401.definition: Problem associated with the deflation of the device including unintended deflation or inadequate deflation.

A140101.definition: Problem associated with the inability to deflate a device which is intended to deflate.

A140102.definition: Problem associated with the unintended deflation of a device which was not designed to deflate or not at that point in time or not to that extent.

A1402.definition: Problem associated with a delivery overdose of therapeutic agents, such as drugs or fluids being delivered into a device or a patient.

A1403.definition: Problem associated with the method or amount of time associated with the delivery of a fluid. Time to delivery or amount of delivered entity may be affected.

A140301.definition: Complete failure to fill as part of an automated process. For insufficient filling use "Short Fill". For excessive filling use "Overfill". For inconsistent filling use "Volume Accuracy Problem".

A140302.definition: Excessive filling of a device. For complete failure to fill use "inability to auto-fill". For insufficient filling use "Short Fill". For inconsistent filling use "Volume Accuracy Problem".

A140303.definition: Insufficient filling of a device. For complete failure to fill use "inability to auto-fill". For insufficient filling use "short fill". For inconsistent filling use "Volume Accuracy Problem".

A140304.definition: Inconsistent filling of a device. This describes a problem which is observed to vary between overfilling and under filling, and may be intermittent. Use "Overfill" or "Short Fill" if problem is consistent.

A1404.definition: Problem associated with the process of passing a substance through a porous medium, e.g., a blood clot filter for the removal of suspended matter.

A140401.definition: Problem associated with the filter failing to remove items or substances which should have been removed.

A140402.definition: Problem associated with the transfer of fluid between the blood and dialysate through the dialysis membrane due to a pressure gradient (trans-membrane pressure) existing between the blood and dialysate compartments.

A1405.definition: Problem associated with the regulation and delivery of therapeutic agents (e.g. air, gas, drugs or fluids into a device or a patient under positive pressure).

A140501.definition: Continuous flow of fluid (e.g. liquid, gas) against the intended flow direction.

A140502.definition: Problem associated with uncontrolled flow of infusion of air, gas or fluids.

A140503.definition: Problem associated with the increased rate of change in temperature, pressure, or other variables as a function of distance, time, etc.

A140504.definition: Delivery at endpoint not as intended; either too low or too high.

A140505.definition: Problem associated with fluctuations in the flow volume delivered per time, even if end volume is correct, and delivered in the correct total time.

A140506.definition: Problem associated with the infusion not being stead- characterised by intermittent stoppages to the flow.

A140507.definition: Problem associated with partial backflow, compromising the device's flow output.

A140508.definition: Problem associated with flow rate. Flow volume delivered over time is not reaching intended flow rate.

A140509.definition: Problem associated with the amount of gas that is inspired and expired during one respiratory cycle.

A1406.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to expand or enlarge with the intended inflation agent (e.g. saline or air).

A1407.definition: Problem associated with an insufficient dose of therapeutic agents, e.g., drugs or fluids being delivered into a patient under positive pressure.

A1408.definition: Problem arising from the device failing to deliver the specified liquid or gas.

A140801.definition: Failure (=complete nonperformance) with regard to the intended function of delivery.

A140802.definition: Failure (=complete nonperformance) with regard to the intended function of infusion.

A140803.definition: Failure (=complete nonperformance) with regard to the intended function of irrigation.

A1409.definition: Problem related to an obstruction or blockage within the device component (e.g. tube, opening, pipe) that results in restriction of flow (including blood clotting).

A140901.definition: Problem related to an obstruction or blockage within the device component (e.g. tube, opening, pipe) that results in no flow.

A140902.definition: Problem related to an obstruction or blockage within the device component (e.g. tube, opening, pipe) that results in a reduction of the flow rate.

A1410.definition: The device is difficult to flush, possibly indicating an obstruction within device.

A1411.definition: Problem associated with the application of a force either internal or external to device that compromises the flow of fluid or gas.

A141101.definition: Unintended decrease in pressure, compromising the device's intended function.

A141102.definition: Unintended increase in pressure, compromising the device's intended function.

A141103.definition: Unintended complete loss of pressure, compromising the device's intended function.

A1412.definition: Problem associated with pump performance deviating from specifications in a way to compromise flow or infusion or dispensing.

A141201.definition: Unintended decrease in pump speed and hence, probably, flow rate, compromising the intended function of the device.

A141202.definition: Unintended increase in pump speed and hence, probably, flow rate, compromising the intended function of the device.

A141203.definition: Problem associated with the device which fails to start pumping.

A1413.definition: Problem associated with suction equipment, which may be a manual, electrical, vacuum or pressure source operated to evacuate and remove undesired substances (air, gas, fluid, or particulates) via tubing and collection bag.

A141301.definition: Problem associated with the removal of fluid or gas from a body cavity or device due to decreased suction.

A141302.definition: Problem associated with the removal of fluid or gas from a body cavity or device due to increased suction.

A141303.definition: Problem associated with the complete inability to provide suction.

A1414.definition: Problem associated with the preparation of the device to begin pumping.

A141401.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to begin the priming process (i.e. the process of preparation of device for the delivery of fluids).

A141402.definition: Problem associated with not adequately preparing the device.

A1415.definition: Problem associated with air in the device (e.g. air in line).

A15.definition: Problem associated with any deviations from the intended performance of the device that relate to the sequence of events for activation, positioning or separation of device. Note: Deployment is synonymous with activation.

A1501.definition: Problem associated with the activation of the device. Note: Activation includes expansion.

A150101.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to be activated including partial activation.

A150102.definition: Problem associated with delayed or difficult activation of the device.

A150103.definition: Problem associated with early and unexpected activation of the device.

A150104.definition: Problem associated with the unexpected or unintended activation of the device or a device function.  For Unintended Power Up use A070804

A150105.definition: Problem associated with a device not responding to key or button inputs.

A1502.definition: Problem associated with the movement of the device to an intended location.

A150201.definition: Problem associated with the inability of the device to be positioned in a specified location.

A150202.definition: Problem associated with the device being positioned in a location other than intended or specified.

A150203.definition: Problem associated with users experiencing difficulty or delay to position the device to a specified location.

A150204.definition: Problem associated with failure to move the device to an intended location.

A150205.definition: Problem associated with difficulty moving the device to an intended location (e.g. difficulty in advancing guide wire).

A150206.definition: Problem associated with problems introducing or inserting the device, even if the user is operating the device in accordance with the instructions for use or labeling.

A150207.definition: Problem associated with the user experiencing difficulty when taking out the device, even if the user is operating device in accordance with the instructions for use or labeling.

A150208.definition: Problem associated with the device caught within patient vasculature, tissue, or other device.

A1503.definition: Problem associated with the detachment or separation of the device.

A150301.definition: Problem associated with the device or one of its components failing to detach or separate as intended.

A150302.definition: Problem associated with users experiencing difficulty or delay with detachment or separation of the device.

A150303.definition: Problem associated with an early and unexpected detachment or separation of the device from the system.

A16.definition: Problem associated with any deviations from the documented specifications of the device that relate to the implemented and inherited design features specific to devices used for reducing risks to patient or caregiver or maintaining risks within specified levels.

A1601.definition: Problem associated with the alarm system of the device.

A160101.definition: The device does not display an alarm message when required.

A160102.definition: The device fails to emit an audible alarm.

A160103.definition: The audible device alarm cannot be heard clearly.

A160104.definition: The device alarm system operates with delay.

A160105.definition: Problem associated with the device providing incorrect alarm warning or alert to user.

A160106.definition: The device alarm does not operate as expected and/or in agreement with device's specifications.

A1602.definition: Problem associated with the feature that prevents the unsafe use of the device.

A160201.definition: Problem associated with the device fail-safe mechanism, which did not function or function in a non effective way, compromising safe use of the device.

A160202.definition: The device does not have a fail-safe mechanism, although such mechanism would be required for its appropriate and/or safe functioning.

A1603.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to perform an internal self-diagnostic process to ensure normal operation during or prior to use.

A1604.definition: Problem associated with the inability of device to turn itself off when the device is not in an operable condition.

A1605.definition: Problem associated with setting a variable, register, or other storage location back to a prescribed state.

A160501.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to set a variable, register, or other storage location back to a prescribed state.

A160502.definition: Problem associated with the device failing to set a variable, register, or other storage location back to zero.

A160503.definition: Problem associated with the device setting a variable, register, or other storage location to an inappropriate or unexpected state.

A1606.definition: Problems with the activation of a protective measure indicator earlier than expected.

A160601.definition: Problems with the early or unexpected activation of the elective replacement indicator.

A160602.definition: Problem with the early or unexpected activation of the end-of-life indicator.

A1607.definition: Problem associated with the device inability to act as a barrier for absorption of radiation energy in X-rays, gamma rays, etc.

A17.definition: Problem associated with compatibility between device, patients or substances (medication, body fluid, etc.)

A1701.definition: Problem associated with the incompatibility of any device while being operated in the same use environment thereby leading to a dysfunction between the devices.

A170101.definition: An accessory required for the intended purpose of the device appears incompatible with device, thus compromising the intended function of the device.

A170102.definition: A component required for the proper functioning of the device is not compatible with other components or subassemblies of the device, thus compromising the intended function of the device.

A1702.definition: Problem associated with the incompatibility of two or more devices while being operated in the same use environment thereby leading to a dysfunction of more than one device.

A1703.definition: Problem associated with the incompatibility of the measurement systems between and/or within device systems that are inherent to the individual device thereby leading to miscalculated or mismatched measurements from those devices, e.g., international metric system versus U.S. measurement system.

A1704.definition: Problem associated with the ability of two or more devices which are intended to be incompatible but are able to work or fit together.

A18.definition: Problem associated with the presence of any unexpected foreign substance found in the device, on its surface or in the package materials, which may affect performance or intended use of the device, or problem that compromise effective decontamination of the device.

A1801.definition: Problem associated with the undesired introduction of impurities either chemical or microbiological in nature, or of foreign matter into or onto the device.

A180101.definition: Problem associated with the undesired introduction of a biofilm coating into or onto the device.

A180102.term: Contamination of Device Ingredient or Reagent
A180102.definition: Problem associated with the undesired introduction of impurities either chemical or microbiological in nature, or of foreign matter into or onto the device ingredient or reagent.

A180103.definition: Problem associated with the undesired presence of body fluid in/on the device, which are not part of the documented device specifications and requirements.

A180104.term: Device Contamination with Chemical or Other Material
A180104.definition: Problem associated with contamination of the device with chemical substance or other non biologic material.

A180105.definition: Problem associated with undesired microbial contamination of the device.

A1802.term: Device Contaminated During Manufacture or Shipping
A1802.definition: Problem associated with the presence of any unexpected foreign substance found on the surface or in the package materials, which may affect optimal performance for its intended use, and which occurred during manufacture or shipping.

A1803.definition: Problem associated with a failure during any step of reprocessing process (cleaning, disinfection, packaging, labeling, sterilization) of a used or opened from its original packaging, but unused, device.

A180301.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the device or operator to remove any visible soil, foreign material or organism deposits on the external surfaces, crevices, and joints of the device.

A180302.definition: Failure to properly disinfect the device when reprocessing it.

A180303.definition: Flushing process was not executed properly.

A180304.term: Problem with Removal of Enzymatic Cleaner
A180304.definition: Enzymatic cleaner was not removed properly.

A180305.definition: Device was not sterilized properly during reprocessing.

A180306.definition: Problem associated with the decontamination process not adequately removing unwanted visible soil, foreign material, or organism deposits.

A1804.term: Device Contaminated at the User Facility
A1804.definition: Problem associated with the presence of any unexpected foreign substance found on the surface or in the package materials, which may affect optimal performance for its intended use, and which occurred at the user facility.

A19.definition: Problem associated with the surrounding conditions in which the device is being used such as temperature, noise, lighting, ventilation, or other external factors such as power supply.

A1901.definition: Problem associated with any undesired acoustic energy or vibration that tends to interfere with the operation of the device.

A1902.definition: Problem associated with compromised device performance at the ambient temperature or the storage at an inappropriate ambient temperature.

A1903.definition: Problem associated with the visibility, odor, or toxicity of an ambient vapor or gas.

A1904.definition: Problem associated with the visibility of molds, mildews, yeasts, and/or mushrooms in the immediate environment in which the device is being used.

A1905.definition: Problem associated with an unsatisfactory humidity level in the storage or use environment which affects the device performance.

A190501.definition: Problem associated with damage inflicted upon the device from water vapor or water in the immediate environment in which the device is being used.

A1906.definition: Problem associated with the circulation of fresh air in the immediate atmosphere in which the device is being used.

A190601.definition: Problem associated with the visibility of water vapor in the immediate atmosphere in which the device is being used.

A1907.term: Device Unsafe to Use in Environment
A1907.definition: Problem associated with environmental condition that results in the unsafe use of the device. (e.g. electromagnetic fields, noise, vibration, microbiological contamination etc.)

A1908.definition: Problem associated with fine solids or liquid particles such as dust, smoke, fume, and/or mist suspended in the immediate atmosphere in which the device is being used.

A1909.definition: Problem associated with the facility-supplied medical gases such as medical air, oxygen, nitrous oxide, and nitrogen.

A1910.definition: Problem associated with the quality of the facility-supplied power.

A191001.definition: Problem associated with the failure of the facility's emergency power backup system(s) including generators and/or interruptible power systems (UPS).

A191002.definition: Problem associated with the failure of primary power supplied by the facility.

A191003.definition: Problem associated with a momentary overpower/over voltage from the utility and electrical systems of user facilities; - Problem associated with inadequate power conditioning such as the presence of fluctuation, surges, spikes, dropouts, noise and other such undesirable transients.

A20.definition: Problem associated with unsatisfactory installation, configuration, and/or setup of a specific device.

A2001.definition: Problem associated with the use of the device characterized by incorrect assembly of device components, parts or constituents.

A21.term: Labelling, Instructions for Use or Training Problem
A21.definition: Problem associated with device markings/labelling, instructions for use, training and maintenance documentation or guidelines.

A2101.definition: Problem associated with the written, printed or graphic material accompanying or affixed to the device or any of its packaging. This includes verbal instructions relating to identification, technical description, and usage provided by the device manufacturers. Problems can include but are not limited to this material being unclear, missing, worn out, incorrect or inaccurate.

A210101.definition: Problem associated with errors in identification of expiration date.

A210102.definition: Problem associated with information unable to be read or deciphered.

A210103.definition: Problem associated with imprecise, inexact information.

A210104.definition: Problem associated with ambiguous, confused information.

A210105.definition: Absence of information e.g. labeling, instruction for use.

A210106.definition: Problem associated with an incorrect label being affixed to the device or packaging.

A2102.term: Lack of Maintenance Documentation or Guidelines
A2102.definition: Problem associated with user facility not receiving adequate service documentation, guidelines, or recommendations to perform preventative and corrective maintenance and performance assurance checks.

A2103.definition: Problem associated with inaccuracies in any written, printed, or graphic matter that is affixed to the device or its packaging with any matter that accompanies the device including verbal instructions related to identification, technical description and use of device provided by the device manufacturers that is intended for healthcare professionals.

A2104.definition: Problem associated with users being unclear and not able to follow any written, printed, or graphic matter that is affixed to device or its packaging with any matter that accompanies the device including verbal instructions related to identification, technical description and use of the device provided by the device manufactures that vary from the standard of medical care in a given environment.

A2105.definition: Problem associated with facility not providing satisfactory initial and/or periodic user training covering operation of the device.

A22.definition: Problem associated with the user experiencing difficulty operating or otherwise interacting with the device, even if the operation is being performed according to labeled instructions for use.

A2201.term: Device Difficult to Setup or Prepare
A2201.definition:
Problem associated with the user experiencing difficulty in preparing the device for use, even if the operation is being performed according to labeled instructions for use.
This includes difficulty attaching or connecting parts together.

A2202.term: Device Difficult to Program or Calibrate
A2202.definition: The device is difficult to program, calibrate or set to desired state, even by appropriately trained user/operator.

A2203.definition: Problem associated with the user's ability to service the device according to the manufacturer specifications relating to the device routine maintenance, i.e., periodic inspection, failure detection, repair, and care of the device to sustain or restore acceptable operating conditions.

A2204.definition: Problem associated with the means by which the operator and the equipment communicate or interact.

A23.definition: Problem associated with failure to process, service, or operate the device according to the manufacturer's recommendations or recognized best practices.

A2301.definition: Handling of the device not in accordance with specification, prior to use on the patient.

A2302.definition: Problem associated with the use of the device in terms of inappropriate or incorrect control settings or incorrect treatment parameters for the device's specified operation and/or intended use.

A2303.term: Improper or Incorrect Procedure or Method
A2303.definition: Problem associated with the use of the device in terms of nonconforming to that device's intended use, specifications, procedure and process or service instructions and information provided by the device manufacturers.

A2304.definition: Problem associated with the device which has been used for an unapproved indication or for an unapproved intended use.

A2305.definition: Problem associated with incorrect assembly of the device or constituents after being put into use.

A230501.definition: Problem associated with incorrect assembly of the device or constituents by the users.

A230502.definition: Problem associated with incorrect assembly of the device or constituents during maintenance or repair.

A24.term: Adverse Event Without Identified Device or Use Problem
A24.definition: An adverse event (e.g. patient harm) appears to have occurred, but there does not appear to have been a problem with the device or the way it was used.

A25.definition: A report has been received but the description provided does not appear to relate to an adverse event. This code allows a report to be recorded for administration purposes, even if it doesn't meet the requirements for adverse event reporting.

A26.definition: An adverse event appears to have occurred but there is not yet enough information available to classify the device problem.

A27.term: Appropriate Device Problem Term/Code Not Available
A27.definition: The device problem is not adequately described by any other term. Note: this code must not be used unless there is no other feasible code. The preferred term should be documented when submitting an adverse event report. This information will be used to determine if a new term should be added to the code table.

E0101.definition: A feeling of falling down which can occur whether the person is standing, sitting or lying down.

E010201.definition: Hernia of brain substance and meninges through a congenital or traumatic opening of the skull.

E0103.definition: A swelling in the brain caused by the presence of excessive fluid.

E0104.definition: Unexpected increase in cerebral blood flow after carotid endarterectomy (CEA) or carotid artery stenting (CAS).

E0105.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the cerebral ventricles.

E0106.definition: The loss of cerebrospinal fluid into the surrounding tissues or outside the body.

E0107.definition: Changes in perception, thinking, or remembering.

E010701.definition: A mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior.

E010702.definition: Loss of intellectual abilities interfering with an individual's social and occupational functions.

E0108.definition: Traumatic brain injury as a result of the action of a mechanical force on the head.

E0109.definition: Sudden, involuntary skeletal muscular contractions of cerebral or brain stem origin.

E010901.definition: A convulsion marked by alternating contracting and relaxing of the muscles.

E010902.definition: A convulsion marked by prolonged contraction of the muscles.

E010903.definition: Epilepsy caused or apparently caused by device. Do not use when epilepsy is a pre-existing condition.

E010904.definition: A life-threatening condition characterised by a single prolonged seizure or a series of seizures without intervening full recovery of consciousness.

E0110.definition: Decreased sensitivity affecting one or more senses

E0111.definition: Increased sensitivity affecting one or more senses

E0112.definition: A sensation of lightheadedness, unsteadiness, turning, spinning or rocking.

E0113.definition: Impairment of verbal communication skills, often resulting from brain damage.

E0114.definition: An acute inflammatory process affecting the brain parenchyma.

E0115.definition: A functional and/or structural disorder of the brain that is acquired or congenital and characterised by mental and neurological symptoms.

E0116.definition: Pain in various parts of the head, not confined to the area of distribution of any nerve.

E0117.definition: A disorder characterized by an abnormal increase of cerebrospinal fluid in the ventricles of the brain.

E0119.definition: A level of awareness that can be described as consistently not responsive to stimuli.

E011901.definition: A state of profound unconsciousness associated with markedly depressed cerebral activity.

E011903.definition: A spontaneous, transient, loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood supply to the brain.

E0120.definition: Systematic and extensive loss or impairment of memory caused by organic or psychological factors. This may be temporary or permanent, and may involve old or recent memories.

E0121.definition: A disorder characterized by acute inflammation of the meninges of the brain and/or spinal cord.

E0122.definition: Neurological conditions resulting in abnormal voluntary or involuntary movement, which may impact the speed, fluency, quality and ease of movement.

E012201.definition: Difficulty moving; distortion or impairment of voluntary movement, as in tic, spasm, or myoclonus.

E012202.definition: Partial or complete loss of function of one or more muscles. It is usually caused by damage to the nervous system.

E012203.definition: Paralysis of the legs and lower part of the body.

E012206.definition: The shaking movement of the whole body or just a certain part of it, often caused by problems of the neurons responsible for muscle action.

E012207.definition: The occurrence of a single contraction or a series of contractions of a muscle.

E012208.definition: A condition that is characterized by an irresistible urgency to move the legs to obtain relief from a strange and uncomfortable sensation in the legs.

E012209.definition: A partial or complete loss of function of one or more of the facial muscles resulting in paralysis of the facial regions. Includes both central and peripheral facial paralysis or palsy.

E0124.definition: Injury to the central or peripheral nervous system.

E012401.definition: Traumatic damage of the spinal cord.

E0125.definition: Intense painful sensation along a nerve or group of nerves.

E0126.definition: A disorder affecting the cranial nerves or the peripheral nervous system. It manifests with pain, tingling, numbness, and muscle weakness.

E0127.definition: The loss of the sensation of feeling in an area of the body.

E0128.definition: Injury to the peripheral nervous system.

E0129.definition: Pain or discomfort caused by exposure of the dentin layer of tooth to thermal, tactile, or other stimuli.

E0130.definition: A change from the patient's baseline sleeping pattern, in the hours slept and/or an alteration/dysfunction in the stages of sleep.

E0131.definition: A term referring to disorders characterized by the disruption of normal speech. It includes stuttering, lisps, dysarthria and voice disorders.

E0132.definition: A chronic adhesive arachnoiditis in the spinal arachnoid, with root and spinal cord symptoms similar to those caused by pressure from a tumor.

E0133.definition: A sudden loss of neurological function secondary to hemorrhage or ischemia in the brain parenchyma due to a vascular event.

E013301.definition: An acute neurological deficit caused by bleeding within the brain or between the brain and the skull.

E013302.definition: An ischemic condition of the brain, producing a persistent focal neurological deficit in the area of distribution of the cerebral arteries.

E0134.definition: conditions characterized by an alteration in the ability to or perception of touch.

E013402.definition: Impairment of tactile sensitivity manifesting as partial loss of sensitivity to sensory stimuli.

E013403.definition: Abnormal touch sensations, such as burning or prickling, that occur without an outside stimulus.

E0135.definition: Conditions characterized by an alteration in taste function or perception

E0136.definition: An involuntary, compulsive, repetitive stereotyped movement.

E0137.definition: A brief attack (from a few minutes to an hour) of cerebral dysfunction of vascular origin, with no persistent neurological deficit.

E0138.definition: Unintended reaction in nerve system caused by electrical stimulation.

E0139.definition: The report describes a non-specific problem with the nervous system. Note: Please use "Appropriate Term / Code Not Available" if the report describes a specific injury but the relevant term does not exist.

E0140.definition: Pressure within the craniospinal compartment is increased.

E0141.definition: The presence of air or gas within the cranial cavity.

E0143.definition: A level of awareness and arousal other than normal.

E014302.definition: A neurological state characterised by decreased ability to perceive and respond.

E0144.definition: Injury to the dura mater, with or without damage to any other layer of the meninges.

E0201.definition: Excessive clenching of the jaw and grinding of the teeth.

E0202.definition: Change from the affected person's usual emotional state.

E020201.definition: Apprehension or uneasiness which may be accompanied by restlessness, tension, tachycardia, and dyspnea.

E020202.definition: A condition marked by ongoing feelings of sadness, despair, loss of energy, diminished interest/pleasure and difficulty dealing with normal daily life.
